findings.evidence: `rg` finds `schemePointsMulEquiv_rootSubgroup` at `GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean:285`, while this file ends after `diagonalTorus_def`; its only point-characterization lemmas, lines 204–233, concern `diagonalTorusCoordinateMap`, not `diagonalTorus`.
findings.fix: Add an `@[simp]` scheme-points theorem analogous to `schemePointsMulEquiv_rootSubgroup`, expressing `schemePointsMulEquiv N A (p ≫ diagonalTorus.hom.hom)` as `diagGL` of the split-torus coordinates.
findings.issue: `diagonalTorus` is only characterized by its relative-spectrum implementation; no theorem states that composing a split-torus scheme point with it yields the corresponding diagonal matrix, so the pointwise conjugation theorem cannot be applied to the actual group-scheme morphism without unfolding internals.

summary: The group-scheme morphism lacks the characteristic theorem connecting it to its advertised action on scheme-valued points.
